data.animaCaption: Standing along a lantern-lit festival walkway beneath crimson maple leaves in a patterned kimono blouse and maroon hakama, she holds a glossy candy apple with a shy, happy smile.

data.promptProse: Along an evening festival path lined with glowing paper lanterns and red maple trees, Chisa wears an arrow-feather patterned kimono top and maroon hakama, holding a shiny crimson candy apple.
